summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc filed a Form 6-K on 5 November 2026 disclosing that subsidiary Caledonia Holdings Zimbabwe (Private) Limited signed an interim financing facilities agreement of up to US$150 million to support construction of the Bilboes gold project in Zimbabwe. The facility is a credit arrangement, not a special situation: a US$50 million revolving tranche at SOFR plus 8.10% and a US$100 million term tranche (US$50 million accordion) at SOFR plus 7.90%, arranged by Stanbic Bank Zimbabwe and CBZ Bank and syndicated across eight Zimbabwean lenders, with a 36-month maturity plus one-year extension option and an 18-month availability and repayment pause on Facility B. It represents the third pillar of the group's four-pillar funding strategy alongside convertible notes and gold hedging. Watch conditions precedent, including additional hedging, and the timing of long-term project finance.
